item.description: Biography Hi, I am a Ph.D. Student at the Assistant Professorship of Embedded Systems and Internet of Things (ESI) of the Technical University of Munich. My research interests include embedded systems, blockchain, and signature schemes.

item.title: Research
item.description: I currently work as an associate researcher at Technical University of Munich (TUM). My research focuses on decentralizing the Internet of Things. Research Interests Embedded Systems Decentralized Consensus Blockchain Light Cryptography

item.title: Sports
item.description: Parkour and Freerunning Since 2008 I work as a coach for Parkour and Freerunning with children and young adults. I try to motivate them for these trend-sports that focus on body control and help to touch physical limits without any competitive spirit. Check out the hompage: [TSV-Herrsching](http://www.tsv-herrsching.de/gymnastik_turnen/?page_id=10). Indoor Training Trampoline Hall Outdoor Other Sports I also enjoy trying all other sorts of sports. Skiing Wind Surfing Mountain Biking Slackline Fencing Paragliding Bouldering Wave Surfing
